main.description: Turn a finished livestream into a VOD. By default the server leaves a draft for place.stream.vod.publishDraft. After migration to private drafts, this mode requires the streamer's OAuth session with the private draft grant. With publish set, the server publishes the VOD when it is ready using the streamer's stored session, and can accept a caller with delegated livestream.manage.

livestream.description: AT-URI of the place.stream.livestream record to finalize into a VOD. Either this or livestreams is required.

livestreams.description: Several livestream records whose recordings make up one VOD: a streamer who started a new record mid-stream splits the recording across them. Recordings are concatenated in the records' creation order, whatever order they are listed in. All must belong to one streamer.

title.description: Title of the video record; the first livestream's title when empty.

publish.description: Publish the place.stream.video record as soon as the VOD is finalized, instead of leaving a draft.

endLivestream.description: Also end any of the livestream records that were never stopped, so the streamer's page stops reading as live.

uploadId.description: Identifier for the finalize job. Retained for backwards compatibility; the draft flow no longer requires the client to poll getUploadStatus.

draftUri.description: The ats:// URI of the draft VOD created for this finalize, when publish is not set. The draft reaches status 'ready' when processing completes.

livestreams.description: The livestream records the VOD is made of, in recording order.

objects.description: How many recorded objects will be concatenated.

ended.description: Livestream records that are now ended (already, or by endLivestream).

errors.name: LivestreamNotFound
errors.description: No livestream with the given URI is known to this node, or the livestreams belong to different streamers.

errors.name: NoRecording
errors.description: The livestream has no recorded MUXL segments to finalize (recording was not enabled, or none completed).

errors.name: NotPermitted
errors.description: The caller is neither the streamer nor a moderator with livestream.manage from them.
